title: Why You Pay Before You Shop
the_thought: The card at the door is the real checkout.
hook: You pay Costco before you shop.

levels.name: The Short
beats: A gold card hits the door scanner. Then the pallets look cheap on purpose. That's the trick. Fiscal 2025 filings show 5.323 billion dollars of membership fees sitting next to 10.383 billion of operating income, while merchandise gross margin was only 11.12 percent. You didn't buy a supermarket. You bought the year at the door, then a short list of pallets. The long receipt at the exit is just the show. The card at the door is the real checkout.
